subject: general
question:
The volume (in cm³) of a sphere with diameter 7 cm is:

Take π = (22)/(7)
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Volume of sphere in terms of diameter (d) = (π ÷ 6) × d³

Given: Diameter d = 7 cm

Volume = (22 ÷ 7 ÷ 6) × 7 × 7 × 7

Volume = (11 ÷ 21) × 343 = 11 × 49 ÷ 3 = 539 ÷ 3

Volume ≈ 179.66 cm³

**∴ The correct answer is 179.66 cm³.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Diameter (d) = 7 cm

**Formula Used:**

Radius (r) = d ÷ 2

Volume of Sphere = (4 ÷ 3) × π × r³

 
 
 
• 
 Diameter = 7 cm
 
• 
 r = 3.5 cm
 Sphere Volume Calculation

**Calculations:**

⇒ Radius (r) = 7 ÷ 2 = 3.5 cm

⇒ Volume = (4 ÷ 3) × (22 ÷ 7) × (3.5) × (3.5) × (3.5)

⇒ Volume = (4 ÷ 3) × (22 ÷ 7) × (7 ÷ 2) × (7 ÷ 2) × (7 ÷ 2)

⇒ Volume = (4 × 22 × 7 × 7 × 7) ÷ (3 × 7 × 2 × 2 × 2)

⇒ Volume = (88 × 49) ÷ (3 × 8)

⇒ Volume = (11 × 49) ÷ 3

⇒ Volume = 539 ÷ 3

⇒ Volume = 179.666... ≈ 179.66 cm³

**∴ The correct answer is 179.66 cm³.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Surface Area of Sphere

The total surface area of a sphere is given by the formula 4 × π × r².

Properties of Hemisphere

Volume = (2 ÷ 3) × π × r³ | Curved Surface Area (CSA) = 2 × π × r² | Total Surface Area (TSA) = 3 × π × r².

Sphere vs Cylinder

The volume of a sphere is 2/3 of the volume of the smallest cylinder that can enclose it.</p
